client_certificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for TLS authentication.

client_key.description: PEM-encoded client certificate key for TLS authentication.

cluster_ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded root certificates bundle for TLS authentication.

config_context.description: Context to choose from the config file. Can be sourced from KUBE_CTX.

config_context_auth_info.description: Authentication info context of the kube config (name of the kubeconfig user, --user flag in kubectl). Can be sourced from KUBE_CTX_AUTH_INFO.

config_context_cluster.description: Cluster context of the kube config (name of the kubeconfig cluster, --cluster flag in kubectl). Can be sourced from KUBE_CTX_CLUSTER.

config_path.description: Path to the kube config file. Can be set with KUBE_CONFIG_PATH.

config_paths.description: A list of paths to kube config files. Can be set with KUBE_CONFIG_PATHS environment variable.

api_version.description: API version for the exec plugin.

command.description: Command to run for Kubernetes exec plugin

env.description: Environment variables for the exec plugin

host.description: The hostname (in form of URI) of kubernetes master

insecure.description: Whether server should be accessed without verifying the TLS certificate.

password.description: The password to use for HTTP basic authentication when accessing the Kubernetes master endpoint.

proxy_url.description: URL to the proxy to be used for all API requests.

tls_server_name.description: Server name passed to the server for SNI and is used in the client to check server certificates against.

token.description: Token to authenticate a service account.

username.description: The username to use for HTTP basic authentication when accessing the Kubernetes master endpoint

local_host.description: The local address to listen on (e.g., 127.0.0.1).

local_port.description: The local port to listen on. If 0, a random port will be chosen.

service_name.description: The name of the service to forward ports to.

target_port.description: The port on the service to forward to.

block.description: Opens a port forward to a Kubernetes service.

local_host.description: The local address to listen on. Defaults to `localhost`.

local_port.description: The local port to listen on. If not set, a random free port is chosen.

ssh_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the SSH bastion host

ssh_key.description: The path to the private key file or the private key content to use for the SSH connection

ssh_key_passphrase.description: The passphrase for the private key file

ssh_password.description: The password to use for the SSH connection

ssh_port.description: The port number of the SSH bastion host

ssh_user.description: The username to use for the SSH connection

target_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the remote host. Required when `target_port` is set; ignored when `target_socket` is set.

target_port.description: The TCP port of the remote host. Mutually exclusive with `target_socket`.

target_socket.description: Path of a unix domain socket on the SSH bastion to forward to. Mutually exclusive with `target_port`.

block.description: Create a local SSH tunnel to a remote host

local_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the local host

local_port.description: The local port to listen on. If not set, a random free port is chosen.

ssm_instance.description: Specify the exact Instance ID of the managed node to connect to for the session

ssm_profile.description: AWS profile name as set in credentials files. Can also be set using either the environment variables `AWS_PROFILE` or `AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE`.

ssm_region.description: AWS Region where the instance is located. The Region must be set. Can also be set using either the environment variables `AWS_REGION` or `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`.

ssm_role_arn.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume.

target_host.description: The DNS name or IP address of the remote host

target_port.description: The port number of the remote host

block.description: Create a local AWS SSM tunnel to a remote host
